Traffic Advisory:

Due to Ganesh Idol Immersion processions, Private Travel Buses are being diverted towards ORR Patancheru at Miyapur Metro Station.

Please cooperate with traffic staff and follow the diversion signs for a smooth flow of traffic.

We appreciate your understanding and support.
